modules.label: W-2
modules.inputDescription: W-2 wage statement for tax year 2024 as a markdown table of box values

modules.label: Parse W-2 Table
modules.note: Markdown table → CSV-style cells → JSON rows (no raw markdown to LLM).
modules.inputDescription: TableRow list parsed from the W-2 wage statement markdown table

fallbackList.typescript: const splitMdRow=(r)=>r.slice(1,-1).split("|").map(c=>c.trim());const mdTableToRows=(body)=>{const t=[];const lines=body.split("\n");let i=0,ti=0;while(i<lines.length){const line=lines[i].trim();if(!line.startsWith("|")||!line.endsWith("|")){i++;continue;}const block=[];while(i<lines.length){const l=lines[i].trim();if(!l.startsWith("|")||!l.endsWith("|"))break;block.push(l);i++;}if(block.length<2)continue;const headers=splitMdRow(block[0]);const data=block.slice(2).filter(l=>!/^[|][\s\-:|]+[|]$/.test(l));t.push({name:"table_"+ ++ti,rows:data.map(ln=>{const c=splitMdRow(ln);const o={};headers.forEach((h,j)=>o[h]=c[j]??"");return o;})});}return t;};const mdFirstTableRows=(body)=>(mdTableToRows(body)[0]?.rows??[]);(doc)=>mdFirstTableRows(doc.content).map((row,i)=>({row_id:String(i+1),cells_json:JSON.stringify(row)}))

fallbackList.typescript: const splitMdRow=(r)=>r.slice(1,-1).split("|").map(c=>c.trim());const mdTableToRows=(body)=>{const t=[];const lines=body.split("\n");let i=0,ti=0;while(i<lines.length){const line=lines[i].trim();if(!line.startsWith("|")||!line.endsWith("|")){i++;continue;}const block=[];while(i<lines.length){const l=lines[i].trim();if(!l.startsWith("|")||!l.endsWith("|"))break;block.push(l);i++;}if(block.length<2)continue;const headers=splitMdRow(block[0]);const data=block.slice(2).filter(l=>!/^[|][\s\-:|]+[|]$/.test(l));t.push({name:"table_"+ ++ti,rows:data.map(ln=>{const c=splitMdRow(ln);const o={};headers.forEach((h,j)=>o[h]=c[j]??"");return o;})});}return t;};const mdFirstTableRows=(body)=>(mdTableToRows(body)[0]?.rows??[]);(combined)=>({table_a_json:JSON.stringify(combined.w2_rows.map((r)=>JSON.parse(r.cells_json))),table_b_json:JSON.stringify(mdFirstTableRows(combined.form_1099.content))})
